scenes.headline: One pan or the other?
scenes.narration: Every kitchen argument ends here. Cast iron or nonstick, which pan deserves the hook on your wall?

scenes.headline: Two pans, two strengths
scenes.narration: Cast iron takes very high heat, sears beautifully and lasts for generations. Nonstick is light, easy to clean and ideal for eggs and delicate fish that would otherwise stick.

right.label: Nonstick
right.text: Gentle on eggs, quick to clean

scenes.headline: Heat is the dividing line
scenes.narration: Nonstick coatings are not meant for very high heat, while cast iron is happiest there.

scenes.headline: Own both, use each well
scenes.narration: If you can only buy one, buy the pan for the food you cook most. Then tell us which one you chose.
